firstPlayerRule: When everyone is ready, the player to the left of the dealer turns over the first Scramble card and reads it aloud.
houseFallback: The rules do not say who deals; use the picker.

sources.title: The Scrambled States of America: Rules

internalEvidence: Fetched the Gamewright-hosted rules PDF listed on gamewright.com/rules and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 2: "When all players are ready, the player to the left of the dealer turns over the top card of the Scramble Deck, places it face-up next to the deck, and reads it aloud."
uncertainty: The rules do not say how the dealer is chosen.
